verdict.rationale: The only explicit streaming evidence is needle.stream(chunks), which streams live speech-transcription words back to the app as two passes agree, plus a general claim of 'OpenAI-compatible APIs for text' that hints at, but does not document, token streaming. Neither shows incremental token-by-token delivery for LLM text generation. Missing for 10: documented token-streaming API or callback for text generation, streaming examples across the bindings, and hands-on corroboration of streamed generation.
